answer: A strong defense is a time-locked bond escrow with slashing. Every agent deposits a 500-token bond and waits 14 days before its signature counts. Each action is signed by that bonded identity, like a quill whose strokes carry the deposit's fingerprint downstream. Proven sybil clones lose 90% of the bond to the reporter, and honest accounts unlock after a long river of 200 confirmed blocks. Flooding 10,000 clones costs 5,000,000 tokens locked plus 4,500,000 burned on first detection, so any whisper network of fakes dies unprofitably. A toll bridge where every car parks its engine as collateral.
